REPOSITORY_CERTIFIED.claim: Static identity and declared consumer contracts agree for the certified population.

ARCHITECTURE_LIVE_CERTIFIED.claim: A successful cohort run covers every repository-known material state vector; it does not directly live-certify every community.

DIRECTLY_LIVE_CERTIFIED.claim: Only recorded owner-observed controls are direct live evidence at design time.

sixLiveBrowserClasses.description: DriveTexas provider lifecycle, governed source-health envelope, current-area records, and consumer publication counts
sixLiveBrowserClasses.whyRepositoryEvidenceCannotClose: Static contracts cannot execute configured network requests or observe terminal source health and current-area publication.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.requiredLiveObservation: Observe request lifecycle, terminal health, current-area IDs/count, consumer-envelope count, and active county/community ownership.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.passCondition: A successful current fetch is explicitly HEALTHY_WITH_DATA or governed HEALTHY_EMPTY; identities/counts and current ownership converge.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.failCondition: Timeout, unavailable/failed/stale state represented as healthy empty; absent envelope; mismatched counts; or stale ownership.

sixLiveBrowserClasses.description: Official Roadway consumer presentation and marker publication
sixLiveBrowserClasses.whyRepositoryEvidenceCannotClose: The repository proves wiring and eligibility, not the live DriveTexas result or rendered Leaflet marker set.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.requiredLiveObservation: Observe source, eligible, published/rendered counts and stable marker identities for the current area.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.passCondition: Counts reconcile and every published map-owned record resolves to the existing exact marker identity.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.failCondition: Count/identity divergence, duplicate marker, missing marker, or previous-area publication remains.

sixLiveBrowserClasses.description: Alerts active-row publication and rendered presentation
sixLiveBrowserClasses.whyRepositoryEvidenceCannotClose: Repository policy cannot establish current live records or attached heading/card DOM.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.requiredLiveObservation: Observe eligible active IDs, displayed IDs, empty reason, heading attachment, card attachment, and ownership.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.passCondition: Nonzero IDs/counts match exactly, or zero is accompanied by a legitimate governed empty reason; DOM is attached and current-owned.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.failCondition: Silent/mislabelled zero, count/ID mismatch, detached presentation, cleared record, or stale card.

sixLiveBrowserClasses.description: Rail viewport, Leaflet marker, and DOM identity parity
sixLiveBrowserClasses.whyRepositoryEvidenceCannotClose: A manifest and governed count cannot prove runtime hydration, viewport policy, Leaflet layers, or attached DOM.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.requiredLiveObservation: Observe source county, inventory count, awareness/policy-visible IDs, Leaflet IDs, and DOM IDs.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.passCondition: ACTIVE_EMPTY has zero runtime inventory; ACTIVE_POSITIVE hydrates current county and policy-visible, Leaflet, and DOM ID sets are exactly equal.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.failCondition: Unexpected nonzero empty state, missing positive inventory, source mismatch, or any ID-set difference.

sixLiveBrowserClasses.description: Alerts Show on map presentation and focus behavior
sixLiveBrowserClasses.whyRepositoryEvidenceCannotClose: Static publication contracts cannot click the action, know initial viewport visibility, or observe focus of an existing marker.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.requiredLiveObservation: For an exact map-owned alert marker, observe action exposure and focus both offscreen and already-visible cases; record a legitimate no-target state only if encountered.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.passCondition: Action focuses the existing exact marker without duplication; already-visible behavior remains stable; no-target records do not expose a false action.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.failCondition: Hidden action for valid target, wrong/new duplicate marker, failed focus, disruptive visible-marker behavior, or false action for no target.

sixLiveBrowserClasses.description: Stale previous-community and previous-county cleanup across transitions
sixLiveBrowserClasses.whyRepositoryEvidenceCannotClose: Repository snapshots do not execute transitions or prove disposal of prior runtime/DOM state.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.requiredLiveObservation: After every transition observe selected canonical community, active county, roadway/rail source counties, and absence of predecessor DriveTexas, rail, awareness, and alert identities.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.passCondition: All current identities/sources converge and every predecessor-owned record, marker, and card is absent.
sixLiveBrowserClasses.failCondition: Any convergence mismatch or any predecessor-owned state survives settlement.

invariantRepositoryContracts: Show on map governed record publication
dynamicLiveOutcomesNotUsedToSplitReposit: Official Roadway target/no-target and initial viewport visibility

selectionMethod.algorithm: Exact deterministic set cover over stateVectorId: because each community has exactly one vector, minimum cardinality equals the number of vectors. For each vector select a candidate that adds a required geographic region where possible, then canonicalKey ascending; pin Fredericksburg to its vector because recorded direct evidence dominates duplicate work. The chosen vector representatives cover all eight required regions, so no augmentation is necessary.

dimensionsClosed: Alerts nonzero with published/active/displayed count 1 and attached DOM

Do not change production files.
